CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

To the Members of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates:

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a special meeting of the City Council to be
called to order at the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 340 Palos Verdes Dr. West, Palos
Verdes Estates, CA at 5:30 p.m. on Tuesday, October 10, 2017. The agenda for the special meeting
with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

Posted by the Office of the City Clerk on Friday, October 6, 2017, at 5:00 p.m.

  October 10, 2017
  5:30 P.M.
  Council Chambers of City Hall
  340 Palos Verdes Dr. West
  Palos Verdes Estates

  AGENDA
  OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on
file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this
agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s
office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk
to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made
available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with
Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a
disability-related modification or accommodation.

The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the
orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to three (3)
minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker’s card, which permits the
City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. The City Council, at the direction of the
Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

   MEMORANDUM

  Agenda Item #: ii_
  Meeting Date: October 10, 2017

TO:  HONORABLE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL

THRU:  ANTON DAHLERBRUCH, CITY MANAGER /s/

FROM:  JACQUELINE WU, ADMINISTRATIVE ANALYST /s/

SUBJECT: COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT TRAINING

DATE:  OCTOBER 10, 2017

Background

The Davenport Institute is working with the City to develop a culture of community
engagement that enhances public participation and trust in City government. Toward that end,
the Davenport Institute will be facilitating “community conversations” and has proffered
recommendations for technology and software to facilitate public connectivity to the City. As
such, the City is implementing public website portals for records and financial data, and the
Davenport Institute will be conducting “community conversations” on:
  • October 12 at Montemalaga Elementary from 5:30 p.m. to 7 p.m.
  • October 14 at Lunada Bay Elementary from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m.
  • October 16 at Valmonte Early Learning Center from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m.
  • October 18 at the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District’s district offices in
  Malaga Cove from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m.

For the “community conversation” meetings, the Davenport Institute is providing training for
public officials. The purpose of this training is to empower Council, staff and City
Commissioners with tools to participate effectively in these meetings and in similar situations
that involve emotional responses.

Invited to the training are all elected officials, Commission / Committee members, and
management staff. The training, to be held in the Council Chambers, will begin at 6:00 p.m.
and conclude at approximately 7:15 p.m. on October 10, 2017.
